content: After pre-training Step with the three tasks introduced in Section SECREF9, we fine-tune the model on abstractive document summarization datasets. The fine-tuning process is straightforward. We simply continue to train Step on the supervised document-summary pairs. Similar to other seq2seq summarization models, we do beam search during the generation of summaries.
